question: Can the frozen confirmed P/L computation be expressed through a 32-channel task interface, a separate deterministic time drive, one binary margin, and a 105-scalar packed local trace without changing any supported output or state transition?
claim_boundary: This is a checkpoint-preserving structural reparameterization, not evidence that episode time is unnecessary and not authorization to delete the historical checkpoints. A separately registered successor must test direct no-time training with the parent four-step support microcircuit.

layout.31: constant one on every active support/query microstep
layout.33: legacy reward; zero in the maintained passive task
layout.34: signed globally admitted support evidence; zero on queries
layout.35:37: legacy previous action; zero in the maintained passive task

external_layout.31: signed globally admitted support evidence; zero on queries

exact_target.time_drive: Keep the legacy normalized time as a separate scalar multiplied by the converted legacy time-column weight. This proves structural equivalence only; the no-time successor sets this drive absent and must retrain.

input_mapping.external_weight: Concatenate legacy i2h columns 0:31 and column 34.
input_mapping.discarded_columns: Legacy columns 33, 35, and 36 are removed only after every maintained active input builder is shown to keep them exactly zero.

exact_target.global_dynamics: Retain W, alpha, eta_E, DA scale, both DA units, tanh activations, clipping, and the exact P-before-E update order.
exact_target.global_margin: margin=(h2o.weight[1]-h2o.weight[0]) h + (h2o.bias[1]-h2o.bias[0]). The common logit mode and unused value output are outside the maintained binary policy claim.
exact_target.local_trace: Pack the strict upper triangle of the normalized antisymmetric conjunctive key into 105 scalars. Its normalized pairwise inner products and accumulated readout are exactly equal to the 225-scalar representation.
exact_target.rollout: Retain four recurrent support microsteps, two query microsteps, per-trial hidden/eligibility reset, persistent P across support trials, persistent L across the episode, and discarded query writes. The legacy two-step initial blank produces no P write under zero hidden and eligibility and may be removed only after its exact P identity is verified.

timestep_accounting.successor_constraint: The first direct no-time training candidate must retain these support microstep and effective-write counts. Variable support horizons require a later separately registered successor.

qualification.active_input_contract: All maintained support and query input builders must set legacy constant to one and reward/previous-action columns to zero; blank handling is checked separately.
qualification.parameter_mapping: Every retained tensor must equal its declared source transform and every discarded tensor must be named.
qualification.single_step: For deterministic active inputs and frozen states, margin, modulation, hidden, eligibility, and P must agree with the legacy model.
qualification.episode: For maintained generic and frozen Liu-shaped support/query panels, terminal P, global margin, local raw margin, local correction, and final margin must agree.
qualification.interventions: Intact, P-off, and L-off outputs must agree and every exact decision must be identical.
qualification.blank_identity: The legacy two blank microsteps must leave P exactly unchanged when hidden and eligibility start at zero.

decision.passed: Every qualification gate passes independently for seeds 2104 and 2105. The exact target may then become the reference implementation for a separately registered no-time training study.
decision.failed: Any mismatch closes this mapping. Repair the implementation or register a changed mapping before scientific no-time training; do not relax tolerances or omit the failing state/output.
decision.historical_retention: No historical checkpoint, gain, frozen result, or report may be deleted by this study.

execution.runtime: CPU float32 qualification first, followed by CUDA eager qualification on both frozen networks before promotion.
execution.source_lock: Freeze the implementation and test hashes after engineering validation and before executing the two frozen-network qualification.
execution.command: direnv exec . python -m fsrl.infra.formal_runtime pl-exact-reparameterization qualify

outputs.retention: Promote the compact result and report plus source/artifact hashes. Converted checkpoint bytes remain runtime artifacts until a later confirmed no-time model and a separate retention migration authorize cleanup.
